d: Chisholm Enterprises is seeking an experienced and commercially minded Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join the business in the Kingdom of Bahrain. With international operations and an expanding aviation platform, this is an opportunity to influence strategy, strengthen financial performance and contribute to the continued development of a dynamic cargo and aviation group.

The CFO will provide strategic and commercial financial leadership, working collaboratively with senior leaders to translate business priorities into clear financial plans and informed decisions. The role will support expansion, investment, fleet and asset initiatives, strong governance, operational performance and sustainable business growth.
q: Professional accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CPA, CIMA or an equivalent internationally recognised qualification.
Significant experience as a CFO, Finance Director or senior executive finance leader within a multifaceted organisation.
Proven experience in financial strategy, business planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting and performance management.
Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to assess opportunities, manage risk and convert strategy into practical action.
Demonstrated experience in treasury, cash flow management, funding, capital structures and relationships with banks or financial institutions.
Sound knowledge of corporate governance, internal controls, statutory obligations and international accounting standards.
Experience within aviation, logistics, transportation, infrastructure or another asset-intensive sector would be highly desirable.
Experience of aircraft financing, leasing, business expansion, acquisitions or major capital investment would be advantageous.
Proven ability to lead, develop and motivate high-performing teams while working collaboratively across functions.
Excellent communication, presenting, influencing and stakeholder-management skills, with credibility at executive and board level.
Strong analytical capability, sound judgement and the confidence to challenge constructively.
Comfort operating in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and internationally focused environment, with a willingness to travel when required.
Experience with Microsoft Dynamics, Power BI, digital transformation or technology-enabled finance improvement would be beneficial.
Strategic and commercially focused, while remaining willing to be hands-on when the business requires it.
Collaborative and relationship-led, with the ability to build trust across the organisation and with external partners.
Clear, resilient and decisive, demonstrating integrity and accountability in all financial matters.
Commercial and improvement-minded, with a genuine interest in supporting growth and creating value.
An empowering leader who sets high standards, develops others and leads by example.
r: Lead the financial strategy, annual business planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance management.
Prepare and present financial and commercial recommendations to the Executive Team and Board, supporting strategic decision-making, investment opportunities and long-term business planning.
Lead the treasury, funding and cash management activities, ensuring financial stability and liquidity to support current operations and future growth.
Strengthen corporate governance, internal controls, statutory reporting and compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
Support aircraft financing, leasing arrangements, acquisitions, insurance programmes and major commercial negotiations.
Partner with operational and departmental leaders to improve reporting, cost management, revenue opportunities and business performance.

Lead, mentor and develop a capable finance team, fostering a positive, proactive, accountable and collaborative culture and ensuring the function effectively supports the strategic objectives of the Group.
Drive continuous improvement in financial systems, management information, governance frameworks, business intelligence and data-driven decision-making.
x: You will join a close-knit, family-owned aviation business where you will play a key role in shaping strategy, supporting growth and contributing to the continued success of a respected and entrepreneurial aviation business.
If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit your CV together with a covering letter to careers@texelair.com.

d: Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world’s most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that’s challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.
Location: This is a Globally remote role
What your day will look like
Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.
What we are looking for in you
You love technology and working with brilliant people
You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
You have experience working with open source communities and licences
You have experience working with C, C++
You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
q: Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.
Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

d: Al Watania Information Systems is seeking a results-driven Account Manager specialized in SAP solutions to join our sales team. In this role, you will own a portfolio of accounts, build and develop pipeline, and position our SAP offerings to new and existing clients across the Kingdom. You will work closely with presales and delivery teams to shape proposals, and carry responsibility for revenue targets within your territory. This position suits candidates with a proven track record selling SAP or enterprise software in the Saudi market.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
Proven experience selling SAP, ERP, or enterprise software solutions.
Track record of carrying and achieving a revenue target.
Strong understanding of the SAP solution portfolio and the enterprise sales cycle.
Established network within the Saudi market.
Excellent negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Proficient in CRM systems for pipeline and forecast management.
r: Own and grow a portfolio of accounts, developing pipeline across new and existing clients.
Identify opportunities and position SAP solutions aligned to client business needs.
Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through to negotiation and closing.
Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at executive and departmental level.
Coordinate with presales and delivery teams to shape proposals, demos, and solution scope.
Prepare commercial proposals, pricing, and contract documentation.
Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, and account data in the CRM system.
Achieve and exceed assigned quarterly and annual revenue targets.
Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and SAP product developments.

d: We serve more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment which encompasses Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium Banking. Within the mass retail sector, our strategic focus is on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us, forming the future pipeline of affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and our deep local presence and international network enables us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.
q: We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.
We’re looking for people who can
Take ownership and show initiative when tackling challenges
Think critically and solve problems using logic, analysis and sound judgement
Learn quickly and stay curious, seeking opportunities to grow and develop
Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others
Adapt and perform under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in clients, markets and global trends.

To be eligible for this internship, you should be a penultimate year student, able to intern in June 2027, and start full time in July 2028. You should have the permanent legal right to work in the country you’re applying to.
You can only submit one application within a six-month period, so take time to review our opportunities and apply for the role that best fits your interests, skills and career goals.

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
r: Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background. Over 10 weeks, you’ll work on real business challenges, build future-ready skills, and gain insight into how we support clients, facilitate trade and finance growth across our markets. Working alongside colleagues across our global network, you’ll develop the skills, confidence and connections to accelerate your career. For many interns, this is the first step towards a graduate role with us.
The programme will support your development through
Exposure to our products, clients and international network
Real projects and meaningful responsibilities from day one
Technical, professional and behavioural skills development
Support from managers, mentors and buddies
Opportunities to learn from senior leaders and industry experts
You’ll be placed into one of the following teams
Affluent Banking: Accelerating wealth growth for our affluent clients – Personal, Premium, Priority, Priority Private and Private Banking.
Wealth Solutions: Committed to building, managing and protecting client’s wealth.
Digital Banking: Using data and NextGen technology to deliver personalised banking solutions.
Bancassurance Performance and Analytics: Supports the business through the application of data, AI, and analytics to enhance performance.
x: In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.
